title: The Lions of Lugou Bridge
synopsis: The Lugou Bridge, also known as the Marco Polo Bridge, is famed for its stone lions.

fullText.simplified:
卢沟桥的狮子

    卢沟桥位于北京市丰台区永定河上，因横跨卢沟河（也就是现在的永定河）而得名，是北京市现存最古老的石造联拱桥。卢沟桥全长266.5米，宽7.5米，有桥墩10座，共11个桥孔。
    说到卢沟桥，就不得不提到卢沟桥上的石狮子。老北京有句谚语：“卢沟桥的狮子——数不清。”而关于卢沟桥狮子的故事也是导游最爱讲，中外游客最爱听的故事。
    据说卢沟桥二百多个汉白玉栏杆上雕刻着不同形态的大狮子，每头大狮子身下藏着不同数量的小狮子。经过几百年的时间，这些狮子有了灵性，活了。大狮子坚守岗位原地不动，小狮子在大狮子之间跑来跑去。当你数到某个大狮子的时候，身下的小狮子有的隐藏起来，有的是前边数过的小狮子跑过来充数的，一直数下去，小狮子一直在变。所以，从头到尾，从尾到头不管你数几遍，总数总是不一样。
    相传，当年清朝的乾隆皇帝不信这个邪，专门派了三个太监来数卢沟桥上面的狮子。但是，三个太监来来回回数了无数次都没有把数量数清楚，最后只能硬着头皮回去交差，结果他们受到了乾隆皇帝的责骂。骂完太监的乾隆皇帝对卢沟桥上的狮子更加好奇了，他决定亲自去数一数，看看是不是真的数不清。于是，他专门抽出了一天的时间来到了卢沟桥。来到卢沟桥的乾隆皇帝看着这些老老实实地“待在原地”的狮子心中更是对卢沟桥的狮子数不清这一说法充满了鄙夷。但是很快，他就被打脸了。当时他信心满满地从桥东数到了桥西，一共数出409只狮子，但是这个数据却与官方记载的数据相差很大。他又从桥西数到了桥东，结果却是得出了438只的数量。这下好了，不但与官方记录对不上了，就连和自己刚刚数的数字也对不上了。这让乾隆帝内心很难接受，于是他又开始了第三轮的数狮子。而第三遍的数量与另外两次的数量依然不同，后来，乾隆帝放弃了。
    看到这儿，可能有人会说：乾隆皇帝数狮子只是个故事，不能证明狮子数不清这一说法。那我们可以再来看看下面的官方新闻：中国建国后，北京文物保护部门为了更好地保护文物，对石狮子逐一进行了编号清查，当时统计的数量为485只。但到了1979年复查时，官方统计数量变成了502只。后来的统计中，石狮子的数量一直在变化。哈哈，卢沟桥上到底有多少只石狮子，看来只有它们自己知道了。
    现如今，卢沟桥已经成为北京著名的旅游景点。每年有无数游客来到卢沟桥，打算做数清石狮子的第一人。遗憾的是，至今为止，还没有一个人能数清。可能卢沟桥的石狮子们也盼着数清他们的那个人快点到来吧！
fullText.traditional:
盧溝橋的獅子

    盧溝橋位於北京市豐台區永定河上，因橫跨盧溝河（也就是現在的永定河）而得名，是北京市現存最古老的石造聯拱橋。盧溝橋全長266.5米，寬7.5米，有橋墩10座，共11個橋孔。
    說到盧溝橋，就不得不提到盧溝橋上的石獅子。老北京有句諺語：“盧溝橋的獅子——數不清。”而關於盧溝橋獅子的故事也是導遊最愛講，中外遊客最愛聽的故事。
    據說盧溝橋二百多個漢白玉欄杆上雕刻著不同形態的大獅子，每頭大獅子身下藏著不同數量的小獅子。經過幾百年的時間，這些獅子有了靈性，活了。大獅子堅守崗位原地不動，小獅子在大獅子之間跑來跑去。當你數到某個大獅子的時候，身下的小獅子有的隱藏起來，有的是前邊數過的小獅子跑過來充數的，一直數下去，小獅子一直在變。所以，從頭到尾，從尾到頭不管你數幾遍，總數總是不一樣。
    相傳，當年清朝的乾隆皇帝不信這個邪，專門派了三個太監來數盧溝橋上面的獅子。但是，三個太監來來回回數了無數次都沒有把數量數清楚，最後只能硬著頭皮回去交差，結果他們受到了乾隆皇帝的責罵。罵完太監的乾隆皇帝對盧溝橋上的獅子更加好奇了，他決定親自去數一數，看看是不是真的數不清。於是，他專門抽出了一天的時間來到了盧溝橋。來到盧溝橋的乾隆皇帝看著這些老老實實地“待在原地”的獅子心中更是對盧溝橋的獅子數不清這一說法充滿了鄙夷。但是很快，他就被打臉了。當時他信心滿滿地從橋東數到了橋西，一共數出409隻獅子，但是這個數據卻與官方記載的數據相差很大。他又從橋西數到了橋東，結果卻是得出了438隻的數量。這下好了，不但與官方記錄對不上了，就連和自己剛剛數的數字也對不上了。這讓乾隆帝內心很難接受，於是他又開始了第三輪的數獅子。而第三遍的數量與另外兩次的數量依然不同，後來，乾隆帝放棄了。
    看到這兒，可能有人會說：乾隆皇帝數獅子只是個故事，不能證明獅子數不清這一說法。那我們可以再來看看下面的官方新聞：中國建國後，北京文物保護部門為了更好地保護文物，對石獅子逐一進行了編號清查，當時統計的數量為485隻。但到了1979年復查時，官方統計數量變成了502隻。後來的統計中，石獅子的數量一直在變化。哈哈，盧溝橋上到底有多少隻石獅子，看來只有牠們自己知道了。
    現如今，盧溝橋已經成為北京著名的旅遊景點。每年有無數遊客來到盧溝橋，打算做數清石獅子的第一人。遺憾的是，至今為止，還沒有一個人能數清。可能盧溝橋的石獅子們也盼著數清他們的那個人快點到來吧！

sentences.simplified: 而第三遍的数量与另外两次的数量依然不同，后来，乾隆帝放弃了。
sentences.traditional: 而第三遍的數量與另外兩次的數量依然不同，後來，乾隆帝放棄了。
sentences.pinyin: ér dì sān biàn de shù liàng yǔ lìng wài liǎng cì de shù liàng yī rán bù tóng hòu lái qián lóng dì fàng qì le
sentences.english: This was hard for the Qianlong Emperor to accept deep down, so he started a third round of counting lions.
But the number he got the third time was still different from the other two times. After many attempts, the Qianlong Emperor gave up.

sentences.simplified: 看到这儿，可能有人会说：
sentences.traditional: 看到這兒，可能有人會說：
sentences.pinyin: kàn dào zhè‘r kě néng yǒu rén huì shuō

sentences.simplified: 乾隆皇帝数狮子只是个故事，不能证明狮子数不清这一说法。
sentences.traditional: 乾隆皇帝數獅子只是個故事，不能證明獅子數不清這一說法。
sentences.pinyin: qián lóng huáng dì shǔ shī zi zhǐ shì ge gù shi bù néng zhèng míng shī zi shǔ bù qīng zhè yì shuō fǎ
sentences.english: Reading this, some people may say:

sentences.simplified: 那我们可以再来看看下面的官方新闻：
sentences.traditional: 那我們可以再來看看下面的官方新聞：
sentences.pinyin: nà wǒ men kě yǐ zài lái kàn kan xià miàn de guān fāng xīn wén
sentences.english: The Qianlong Emperor counting lions is just a story, which cannot prove the claim that the lions cannot be counted.

sentences.simplified: 中国建国后，
sentences.traditional: 中國建國後，
sentences.pinyin: zhōng guó jiàn guó hòu
sentences.english: Then let’s take a look at the following official news:

sentences.simplified: 北京文物保护部门为了更好地保护文物，
sentences.traditional: 北京文物保護部門為了更好地保護文物，
sentences.pinyin: běi jīng wén wù bǎo hù bù mén wèi le gèng hǎo de bǎo hù wén wù
sentences.english: After the founding of the People’s Republic of China, ..

sentences.simplified: 对石狮子逐一进行了编号清查，
sentences.traditional: 對石獅子逐一進行了編號清查，
sentences.pinyin: duì shí shī zi zhú yí jìn xíng le biān hào qīng chá
sentences.english: .. in order to better protect cultural relics, the Beijing Cultural Relics Protection Department ..

sentences.simplified: 当时统计的数量为485只。
sentences.traditional: 當時統計的數量為485隻。
sentences.pinyin: dāng shí tǒng jì de shù liàng wèi 5 zhī
sentences.english: .. conducted a numbered inventory of the stone lions.

sentences.simplified: 但到了1979年复查时，官方统计数量变成了502只。
sentences.traditional: 但到了1979年復查時，官方統計數量變成了502隻。
sentences.pinyin: dàn dào le 4 nián fù chá shí guān fāng tǒng jì shù liàng biàn chéng le 4 zhī
sentences.english: The number of lions counted at the time was 485.

sentences.simplified: 后来的统计中，石狮子的数量一直在变化。
sentences.traditional: 後來的統計中，石獅子的數量一直在變化。
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái de tǒng jì zhōng shí shī zi de shù liàng yì zhí zài biàn huà
sentences.english: But by the time of the 1979 review, the official number of lions had become 502.

sentences.simplified: 哈哈，卢沟桥上到底有多少只石狮子，看来只有它们自己知道了。
sentences.traditional: 哈哈，盧溝橋上到底有多少隻石獅子，看來只有牠們自己知道了。
sentences.pinyin: hā hā lú gōu qiáo shang dào dǐ yǒu duō shao zhī shí shī zi kàn lái zhǐ yǒu tā men zì jǐ zhī dào le
sentences.english: The number of stone lions has been continuously changing in subsequent figures.
Haha, it seems that only the lions themselves know how many stone lions there are on Lugou Bridge.

sentences.simplified: 现如今，卢沟桥已经成为北京著名的旅游景点。
sentences.traditional: 現如今，盧溝橋已經成為北京著名的旅遊景點。
sentences.pinyin: xiàn rú jīn lú gōu qiáo yǐ jīng chéng wéi běi jīng zhù míng de lǚ yóu jǐng diǎn

sentences.simplified: 每年有无数游客来到卢沟桥，打算做数清石狮子的第一人。
sentences.traditional: 每年有無數遊客來到盧溝橋，打算做數清石獅子的第一人。
sentences.pinyin: měi nián yǒu wú shù yóu kè lái dào lú gōu qiáo dǎ suàn zuò shǔ qīng shí shī zi de dì yī rén
sentences.english: Nowadays, Lugou Bridge has become a famous tourist attraction in Beijing.

sentences.simplified: 遗憾的是，至今为止，还没有一个人能数清。
sentences.traditional: 遺憾的是，至今為止，還沒有一個人能數清。
sentences.pinyin: yí hàn de shì zhì jīn wéi zhǐ hái méi yǒu yí ge rén néng shǔ qīng
sentences.english: Countless tourists come to Lugou Bridge every year, intending to be the first to accurately count the stone lions.

sentences.simplified: 可能卢沟桥的石狮子们也盼着数清他们的那个人快点到来吧！
sentences.traditional: 可能盧溝橋的石獅子們也盼著數清他們的那個人快點到來吧！
sentences.pinyin: kě néng lú gōu qiáo de shí shī zi men yě pàn zhe shǔ qīng tā men de nà ge rén kuài diǎn dào lái ba
sentences.english: Unfortunately, so far, no one has been able to determine how many there are.

sentence_translations: The Lions of Lugou Bridge
Located on the Yongding River in Fengtai District, Beijing, ..
.. Lugou Bridge is named after the Lugou River (now known as the Yongding River), which it spans.
It is the oldest surviving segmented stone arch bridge in Beijing.
Lugou Bridge is 266.5 meters long and 7.5 meters wide, with 10 piers and 11 arches in total.
Speaking of the Lugou Bridge, we have to mention the Lugou Bridge’s stone lions.
There is an old Beijing proverb: “The lions of Lugou Bridge are too numerous to count.”
The story of the lions of Lugou Bridge is also the most popular story for tour guides to tell and for Chinese and foreign tourists to hear.
It is said that more than 200 white marble railings on Lugou Bridge are carved with large lions in different forms, ..
.. and each large lion has a different number of small lions hidden underneath.
After hundreds of years, these lions gained spiritual being and came to life.
The large lions remain at their posts and do not move, whereas the small lions run around between the big lions.
When you reach a certain big lion during your count, some of the small lions under it will start hiding, ..
.. and some of the small lions you’ve already counted will come running over to make up the number.
As you keep counting, the small lions keep changing.
So, from beginning to end, from end to beginning, no matter how many times you count, the total is always different.
According to legend, the Qianlong Emperor of the Qing Dynasty did not believe in this heresy, ..
.. and specifically sent three eunuchs to count the lions on Lugou Bridge.
However, the three eunuchs went back and forth countless times but could not determine the exact number of lions.
In the end, they had to summon up the courage to report back, and as a result, they were scolded by the Qianlong Emporor.
After scolding the eunuchs, the Qianlong Emperor became even more curious about the lions of Lugou Bridge.
He decided to count them himself to see if it really was impossible to determine the exact number.
So, he specifically set aside a day to come to Lugou Bridge.
When the Qianlong Emporer arrived at Lugou Bridge and saw these lions honestly “staying in their place”, ..
.. he was filled with contempt for the claim that the number of lions on the bridge could not be determined.
But soon, he was proven wrong.
At that time, he confidently counted from the east to the west of the bridge, and counted a total of 409 lions.
But this figure was very different from the official record.
He counted again from the west to the east of the bridge, but the resulting amount was 438.
Just great! Not only did it not match the official record, but it also didn’t match the number he had just counted.
This was hard for the Qianlong Emperor to accept deep down, so he started a third round of counting lions.
But the number he got the third time was still different from the other two times. After many attempts, the Qianlong Emperor gave up.
Reading this, some people may say:
The Qianlong Emperor counting lions is just a story, which cannot prove the claim that the lions cannot be counted.
Then let’s take a look at the following official news:
After the founding of the People’s Republic of China, ..
.. in order to better protect cultural relics, the Beijing Cultural Relics Protection Department ..
.. conducted a numbered inventory of the stone lions.
The number of lions counted at the time was 485.
But by the time of the 1979 review, the official number of lions had become 502.
The number of stone lions has been continuously changing in subsequent figures.
Haha, it seems that only the lions themselves know how many stone lions there are on Lugou Bridge.
Nowadays, Lugou Bridge has become a famous tourist attraction in Beijing.
Countless tourists come to Lugou Bridge every year, intending to be the first to accurately count the stone lions.
Unfortunately, so far, no one has been able to determine how many there are.
Maybe the stone lions of Lugou Bridge are looking forward to the arrival of the person who can accurately count them!
